trials.claim: All future Plus Tier 1 or Agency Tier 2 plan updates included
trials.claimQuote: All future Plus (Tier 1) or Agency (Tier 2) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The terms state lifetime holders pay no additional fees and explicitly include access to updates and support; the product-lifespan wording does not show updates being withheld while the product exists.

exhibits.quote: The term 'lifetime' refers to the lifespan of the product or plugin, not the user.
exhibits.argument: The lifetime promise is limited to the product lifespan, not the buyer lifetime.

exhibits.quote: However, after discontinuation, we will no longer provide updates or support for the product.
exhibits.argument: Future updates can be cut off entirely if the product is discontinued.

exhibits.quote: Lifetime license holders will not be required to pay any additional fees for the specific product they have purchased.
exhibits.argument: This confirms lifetime buyers get no extra fees for their product, supporting included future updates.

exhibits.quote: This includes access to updates and support for the product.
exhibits.argument: This explicitly states lifetime licenses include updates and support.

trials.claim: Support is available to address issues that arise
trials.claimQuote: If any issues arise, support is available to address them.
trials.reasoning: The vendor promises its support team will try to solve problems, and a buyer reports support responds quickly with real people; the expiration wording does not show active buyers being denied support.

exhibits.quote: Access to support services ceases upon the expiration or cancellation of your subscription or warranty.
exhibits.argument: Support ends on expiration or cancellation rather than remaining available for issues.

exhibits.quote: Users with expired or canceled subscriptions are not eligible for support.
exhibits.argument: Expired users are expressly excluded from support eligibility.

exhibits.quote: If it is solvable, then our support team will do their best for you otherwise, you will get the refund within seven working days.
exhibits.argument: This shows the vendor promises support will attempt to solve product problems.

exhibits.quote: drag and drop was smooth and support responds quickly and not just your usual AI responses, actual people read and reply
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms support actually responds quickly with real people to address issues.

trials.claim: Builds beautiful, functional forms for WordPress with drag-and-drop ease
trials.claimQuote: Build beautiful, functional forms for WordPress with drag-and-drop ease
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report the builder is slower, more painful, time-consuming and confusing, directly conflicting with drag-and-drop ease and outweighing the single positive ease review.

exhibits.quote: The styling and UI need a lot of work, while you can achieve just about anything any other form builder can, it's noticeably slower and more painful.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the builder is slower and more painful rather than easy.

exhibits.quote: After buying it and trying to set it up, I found it time-consuming and confusing to get it to work and send to clients for signature, and too basic.
exhibits.argument: Buyer found setup time-consuming and confusing instead of drag-and-drop ease.

exhibits.quote: With Bit Form, simply drag, drop, and design your dream form with ease.
exhibits.argument: This is the vendor's own claim that forms are built with drag-drop ease.

exhibits.quote: The form builder is easy to set up, and the form-to-PDF feature is the reason I bought it.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms the form builder is easy to set up in practice.

trials.claim: Offers drag-and-drop builder, conditional logic, integrations and fast loading
trials.claimQuote: Bit Form offers a drag-and-drop builder, advanced conditional logic, integrations with tools like Google Sheets and Mailchimp, and optimized performance for fast form loading.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report a webhook integration never delivered data and email delivery failed despite correct SMTP setup, directly undercutting the promised working integrations and outweighing the single positive integrations review.

exhibits.quote: I tried to set up a webhook to send form data to my CRM, but the data never arrived, which didn’t give me confidence in your tool.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports integration failed because webhook data never arrived.

exhibits.quote: No matter how much I set up the SMTP perfectly, it just didn't work, and the form simply didn’t reach my email.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports email delivery failed despite correct setup, undermining functional integrations.

exhibits.quote: Create & manage your form with 45+ drag & drop fields.
exhibits.argument: This confirms the vendor offers a drag-and-drop builder with many fields.

exhibits.quote: The conditional logic and built-in integrations work perfectly, saving me hours of manual work and additional third-party connectors.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms conditional logic and built-in integrations work as promised.

trials.claim: Compatible with major WordPress page builders including Elementor and Divi
trials.claimQuote: Yes, Bit Form is compatible with major WordPress page builders such as Elementor, Oxygen, Divi, Zion, Thrive, and Themify.
trials.reasoning: The vendor explicitly lists Elementor, Divi and other page builders as compatible, and a buyer confirms flawless Divi 5 integration in real use; the generic compatibility disclaimer does not show incompatibility.

exhibits.quote: Plugin Compatibility: We are not responsible for compatibility issues with other software.
exhibits.argument: Vendor disclaims responsibility for compatibility issues despite claiming page-builder compatibility.

exhibits.quote: Bit Form is compatible with almost all the WordPress page builders like- Elementor, Oxygen, Divi, Zion, Thrive, Themify & many more.
exhibits.argument: This is the vendor explicitly stating compatibility with Elementor and Divi among others.

exhibits.quote: I’m currently using the Pro version on my latest project, umjetneograde.com, and the integration with Divi 5 is flawless.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms flawless integration with Divi in real use.
